current_public_wording: beta self-certification and conformance evidence baseline
future_allowed_wording: certified for the exact named certification target recorded in this gate

certification_scope.target: OIDF OpenID Provider Config + Basic internal evidence baseline
certification_scope.notes: The Phase 2 internal target is selected for evidence work only. Public certified wording remains blocked until formal external submission, review, and listing evidence are complete.

required_evidence.description: Select the exact certification target before using certified wording.
Record the Phase 2 internal certification evidence bundle separately from public claim activation.
Every claim-bearing OIDF/OAuth/FAPI plan has archived PASS exports, suite commit, plan JSON, result JSON, and release index links before public certified wording is activated.
All REVIEW, WARNING, and SKIPPED modules are resolved or documented as outside the claimed certification scope.
If formal OIDF or similar certification is claimed, fee, legal, submission, review, and public listing steps are complete.
Product positioning names the exact certified scope and does not imply broader protocol, deployment, or UI certification.
